archetypes.name: dyn-zero-findings-classification
archetypes.rationale: New empty-ballot short-circuit must not regress the ok_count==0 degraded-empty-collector path (#4790) or the PANEL_PRUNED_EMPTY / panel-failed paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the new zero-findings short-circuit added to execute_round in python/plan_review_round.py. Verify the ok_count>0 guard leaves the ok_count==0 empty-collection case on the existing voter-dispatch and _classify_round_loop_status path so degraded-empty-collector (#4790) is preserved. Confirm the empty-ballot regex predicate matches a genuinely empty composed ballot and never a populated one containing FINDING_/OOS_ rows. Check that the emitted values (LOOP_STATUS, TALLY_PLAN_REVIEW_STATUS, DEGRADED_PANEL, ACCEPTED_COUNT, REASON, ROUNDS_COMPLETED) match what downstream plan_review.py consumers expect for the benign zero-findings-degraded-panel outcome. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
